commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' 2 - 2 Goal! Karim Onisiwo tees up Tom Krauss (Mainz) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top right corner. 2:2.
90+6' Mainz are awarded a free kick.
90+5' A yellow-coloured card is received by Anthony Losilla (Bochum).
90+4' Aymen Barkok (Mainz) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+3' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+2' Bochum are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Manuel Riemann makes a brilliant save! Aymen Barkok (Mainz) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the top left corner but is saved by the keeper!
88' Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
87' Substitution. Sepp van den Berg walks off the pitch and Edimilson Fernandes (Mainz) comes on as a substitute.
85' It's time for a substitution. Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes on in place of Keven Schlotterbeck.
84' Thomas Letsch has decided to make a change. Noah Loosli (Bochum) replaces Takuma Asano.

82' 2 - 1 Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) is in the right place at the right time to meet a well-executed corner kick. His close-range header glances off the right post into the goal and increases the score of today's match. It's now 2:1.
82' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
81' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
80' The possession of the ball – 52:48.
79' Danny da Costa (Mainz) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
78' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle and it's Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
78' Robin Zentner (Mainz) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
75' The resulting corner from Anthony Caci (Mainz) is cleared by the defence.
75' Substitution. Josuha Guilavogui (Mainz) in, Brajan Gruda out.
73' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
72' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
71' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
71' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
70' The shots on goal statistics – 3:0.
69' Robin Zentner makes a world class save! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) fires to the bottom right corner, but it's not enough to beat the excellent goalkeeper.
69' Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle after Aymen Barkok (Mainz) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
67' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Moritz Broschinski and he is replaced by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Philipp Forster as he is replaced by Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum).
66' The Bochum players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' Danny da Costa (Mainz) fails to find the target. The goalkeeper, rooted to the spot, watches on helplessly as the volley goes well wide of the right post. The goalkeeper rode his luck there.
59' 1 - 1 OWN GOAL! Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) scores an unlucky own goal after he deflected a shot which went into his own net! 1:1.
59' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) steps up to send the ball in.
58' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
55' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
54' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bochum.
52' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Mainz was in an offside position.
51' What was Bernardo (Bochum) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
47' A goal, which was scored by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum), was disallowed due to offside.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Bo Svensson gives a chance to Aymen Barkok and Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Patrick Ittrich starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Takuma Asano (Bochum) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45+3' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) is able to continue to play.
45+2' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Mainz are ruled offside.
42' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
42' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
40' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
39' Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) tackles a bit over-zealously and Patrick Ittrich blows for a foul.
36' A crossfield pass from Manuel Riemann (Bochum) fails to find any of his teammates.
35' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Erhan Masovic comes onto the pitch to replace him.
33' Here is a change. Stefan Bell is going off and Bo Svensson gives the last tactical orders to Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz).
33' The manager makes a subsitution with Tom Krauss (Mainz) coming on for Dominik Kohr.
32' The game is interrupted now, Ivan Ordets (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
31' Sepp van den Berg (Mainz) commits a rough challenge and Patrick Ittrich blows his whistle for a foul.
31' The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
28' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
27' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
26' There's an opportunity for Philipp Forster (Bochum) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
25' Karim Onisiwo (Mainz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Mainz will have a throw-in.
21' 1 - 0 Goal! Kevin Stoger (Bochum) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Robin Zentner into the bottom right corner.
20' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) is going to take the penalty!
20' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
20' It’s a PENALTY to Bochum after the VAR review!
19' Referee Patrick Ittrich makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
19' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bochum for a penalty. Play continues.
18' Bochum quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
18' Danilo Teodoro Soares (Bochum) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
15' Leandro Barreiro (Mainz) has tested the patience of referee Patrick Ittrich and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Brajan Gruda (Mainz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
13' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Ludovic Ajorque (Mainz).
10' Neat passing move from Bochum in order to create new attacking opportunities.
8' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) jumps into a tackle and Patrick Ittrich signals a foul.
7' Takuma Asano (Bochum) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
6' A pass by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Bochum take a short corner kick.

3' Well-positioned Bernardo (Bochum) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the left post, but Robin Zentner reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
Patrick Ittrich is the one to supervise the game today.
